note: Axes for the idea grid. Items name model families and argument pressures already mapped in knowledge/; 'lanes' points workers at the relevant knowledge directories. Adding an item is fine; renumbering is not, because cell IDs are built from item IDs.

physics.label: Special relativity: Minkowski causal structure, simultaneity conventions, Malament/Stein definability
General relativity with global hyperbolicity: time functions, foliations, cosmological time
Spacetimes with closed timelike curves: Godel, chronology violation, consistency conditions
Causal sets: classical sequential growth, covariance, embedding and reconstruction
Page-Wootters and the relational trinity: constrained states, clock POVMs, conditioning
Quantum reference frames, including temporal and non-tensor-factor frames
Process matrices and indefinite causal order
Thermal time and modular flow on algebra/state pairs
Algebraic and locally covariant QFT: Haag-Kastler axioms, Reeh-Schlieder, Bisognano-Wichmann
Stochastic dynamics: Markov processes versus their path-space measures, filtrations
Theories with a preferred foliation: Bohmian mechanics, relativistic GRW, Tomonaga-Schwinger
Canonical quantum gravity and the problem of time: Wheeler-DeWitt, Dirac constraints
Statistical mechanics with low-entropy boundary conditions: records and the Past Hypothesis

bridges.label: Only structure invariant under the theory's symmetries is real (e.g. SR eliminates a global present)
A relation uniquely definable from the physical structure is ontologically privileged
A complete existing history entails determinism or a fixed future
Temporal experience is evidence of objective passage
Truths about the past require present or existing truthmakers
Self-location: an observer cannot know it is at the growing edge
A relational clock construction exhausts the role of fundamental time
The entropic or record arrow settles which temporal ontology is true
Extra temporal structure is excluded unless it is empirically detectable
A growth process and its completed history are equivalent descriptions
The future is open if and only if the dynamics is indeterministic
Definiteness is the causal past of an event (Stein-style local becoming)
